Reached through jscodeshift 17.4.0 via @babel/core -> @babel/helper-compilation-targets -> browserslist. jscodeshift is a dependency of modern-cmdk-codemod (1.5.0), so npm installs this package, with browserslist and @babel/core, into every consumer's node_modules; no tarball of ours contains it, and its own package carries the licence text and attribution. In modern-cmdk, jscodeshift is bundled into dist/codemod until 2.0 and tsdown inlines only @babel/parser from that tree: caniuse-lite, browserslist and @babel/core are absent from every built dist file (checked 2026-11-05), and modern-cmdk has no dependency on jscodeshift.
